name: KSudoku
tagline: Complete a numeric puzzle with the numbers from one to nine
blurb: KSudoku is a free version of the popular logic game Sudoku developed by the KDE community.
description:
KSudoku is a free version of the popular logic game Sudoku developed by the KDE community.
The game is to fill a nine by nine grid with the numbers from one to nine filling
the rows, columns and three by three squares without repeating a value on them.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
